results.title: Correctness of the zero-one knapsack algorithm

results.title: Exact cost of the knapsack algorithm

results.title: The signature of one oracle
results.caption: Abbreviation
results.summary: For types $X$ and $Y$, this is the polynomial functor whose operations are the queries $x \in X$, each answered by an element of $Y$.

results.title: Adaptive oracle algorithms
results.caption: Abbreviation
results.summary: For a type $X$ of queries, a type $Y$ of answers and a type $\alpha$ of outputs, an adaptive deterministic oracle algorithm is an element of CSLib's free monad over the polynomial functor of one oracle with queries $X$ and answers $Y$. It is built inductively: it either stops with an output in $\alpha$, or asks a query $x \in X$ and continues with an algorithm that depends on the answer $y \in Y$.

results.title: The oracle algorithm that stops at once

results.title: Query step
results.caption: Abbreviation
results.summary: For a point $x \in X$ and a continuation $k$ assigning an oracle algorithm to each answer $y \in Y$, the oracle algorithm that first queries $x$ and then continues with $k(y)$, where $y$ is the answer.

results.title: Running an oracle algorithm
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Given a function $O : X \to Y$, the run of an oracle algorithm with queries in $X$, answers in $Y$ and outputs in $\alpha$ is its output when every query $x$ is answered by $O(x)$: an algorithm that stops with output $a$ runs to $a$, and one that queries $x$ and continues with $k(y)$ on answer $y$ runs to the run of $k(O(x))$.

results.title: Queries of an oracle algorithm
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For an oracle algorithm $c$ and a function $O : X \to Y$, the queries of $c$ against $O$ are the list of the points of $X$ that $c$ asks, in order, when every query $x$ is answered by $O(x)$: the empty list if $c$ stops, and otherwise the first query $x$ followed by the queries of the continuation on the answer $O(x)$.

results.title: Locality of oracle runs
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $c$ be an oracle algorithm and let $O, O' : X \to Y$ agree at every query of $c$ against $O$. Then $c$ has the same output against $O$ as against $O'$, and the same list of queries against $O$ as against $O'$.

results.title: Running a sequential composition

Running against $O$ the composition that first runs $c$ and then continues with $g$ applied to its output gives the output of $g(a)$ run against $O$, where $a$ is the output of $c$ run against $O$.

results.title: Parameters of the admixture model

results.title: Joint weight of an allele copy and its ancestral population
